name: Bujold the Intrepid
firstMeet: Bujold's Retreat, the camp on Solstheim's eastern shore where the Nords driven out of Thirsk Mead Hall wait to take it back; the hall is up on the hill
changes: Once Thirsk Mead Hall is retaken (Retaking Thirsk), she keeps the same hours in Thirsk Mead Hall instead of the camp
In Retaking Thirsk she asks you to meet her at Hrothmund's Barrow; if you oppose her there she attacks you and you may have to kill her
If you side with the rieklings in The Chief of Thirsk Hall, she and the other Nords are the ones you're sent to kill, and they stay out of the hall for good
role: leader of the Nords of Thirsk Mead Hall; quest giver

quests.how: gives it; you go with her to Hrothmund's Barrow, and opposing her there can end in a fight to the death
its target if you join the rieklings' assault on the Nords

canDie: protected (only you can kill her); a quest-only essential alias covers her for part of Retaking Thirsk

unsure.why: both her sleep routines also need a second game setting to be off; the extract doesn't say what that setting tracks, and if it's on she doesn't follow the sleep hours
the switch between camp and hall is a game setting the extract doesn't name; tying it to retaking the hall comes from the routines' names and the quest's journal text
the places extract's distances on Solstheim look wrong (it puts Raven Rock under a kilometre from Skaal Village), so no distance to the camp is given
she fills aliases in eleven other quests that aren't in the quest extracts (probably scenes and dialogue), so none are listed
her class comes from a Requiem patch and is only a form id; no extract names it
